data.title: BAföG approval notice (Bescheid über Ausbildungsförderung)
data.summary: The Studierendenwerk Mustertor's Amt für Ausbildungsförderung approved Laura Beispielwinkel's BAföG application for the funding period April 2025 to March 2026, granting €734.00 per month (half as a grant, half as an interest-free state loan), paid at the end of each month for the following month.
data.explanation: This letter confirms you have been approved for BAföG student financial aid of €734 per month from April 2025 to March 2026, paid at the end of each month for the following month; half is a non-repayable grant and half an interest-free loan. You must tell the office immediately if your income, address or studies change. If you think the decision is wrong (e.g. the amount or how your parents' income was counted), you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. Otherwise, no action is needed and payments continue automatically each month.
